title: Efficient and accurate tiller counting of hand-collected samples using images of straw bundles
author: Saravanan, Latsch, et al.

steps.title: Strap bundles tightly
steps.instruction: Fasten each wheat straw bundle with three straps using a standard parcel strapping machine (Orgapack, Dietikon, Switzerland); after an initial adjustment, apply the same strapping force to all bundles to keep tillers from dislodging or being squeezed.

steps.title: Cut clean cross‑sections
steps.instruction: Secure the bundle with a custom‑made wooden clamp, then cut each longitudinal side with an electric saw (JR3060T Makita, Aichi, Japan) equipped with a fiber‑insulation blade (S1213AWP, Bosch, Stuttgart, Germany) to obtain a flat, fray‑free vertical surface; collect the top‑cut residuals that contain wheat ears for separate processing and discard the bottom residuals.

steps.title: Set up imaging box
steps.instruction: Place the cut bundle inside a dark wooden box so that the freshly cut surface faces the open side; illuminate the surface with a standard photography lamp (Kaiser studiolight 1000, Kaiser Fototechnik, Buchen, Germany) positioned at an incidence angle of approximately 45° to provide constant, high‑contrast lighting.

steps.title: Capture standardized images
steps.instruction: Using a Nikon D5100 DSLR (Nikon, Minato, Japan) in manual mode, set aperture to F22, ISO to 100, and exposure time to 0.17 s; employ autofocus for consistent focal positioning and acquire one image of each side of the bundle (front and back).

steps.title: Analyze images with TillerCounter
steps.instruction: Open each image in the TillerCounter program, run the Hough detection to obtain the “Hough count”, then manually add or remove detections to produce the final “Hough + adjusted count” (Hough + adjusted = Hough count + manually added – manually removed).

steps.title: Optional manual validation
steps.instruction: For a validation subset, manually mark each tiller in the image using GIMP, count the marked tillers (annotation count), and optionally disassemble the bundle to count tillers by hand (ground‑truth count).
